keyword.title: Filter by keyword
keyword.description: Only return tenders whose procuring entity or description contains this text (case-insensitive). Leave blank to return every tender currently on NPPA's Bids/Tenders board.

keywords.title: Filter by multiple keywords
keywords.description: Run multiple keyword filters in one job (each produces its own tagged set of matching records). Combined with 'keyword' if both are set.

onlyOpenTenders.title: Only open (not yet expired) tenders
onlyOpenTenders.description: If true, excludes tenders whose Expiration Date has already passed. NPPA's board is a running log and does not remove expired entries on its own, so this actor computes it from the (inconsistently formatted) Expiration Date column -- rows where that date can't be parsed are kept either way.

maxResults.title: Max results per keyword
maxResults.description: Caps how many tender records are pushed to the dataset per keyword (or overall, if no keyword is given). The whole board is a single page (~30 rows as of this actor's last check), so this mostly exists as a safety cap.
